Title: Ducae Michaelis Ducae nepotis Historia Byzantina, recognovit et interprete Italo addito supplevit Immanuel Bekkerus (Corpus scriptorum historiae Byzantinae)
Creator: Doukas (Ducas), Byzantine historian (catalogue dates c. 1400 to c. 1470); Greek text edited by Immanuel Bekker, Bonn Corpus; Latin translation by Ismael Boulliau (catalogue note; Bekker's text calls him Bullialdus)
Publisher: Bonn: Impensis Ed. Weberi, 1834 (title page MDCCCXXXIV)
Publication Date: 1834
Rights: Public Domain (pre-1930 publication); the item record carries the Public Domain Mark 1.0 licence (creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/)
Language: grc (mixed: Greek text with Boulliau's Latin translation and Bekker's Latin preface and notes; the Greek is about one quarter of the text by letter count; not a pure-Greek witness)
Source: Internet Archive item bub_gb_fNQFAAAAQAAJ, full-text OCR file bub_gb_fNQFAAAAQAAJ_djvu.txt, fetched directly by the library/source-research thread, 2026-09-29. The item record's licence field is the Public Domain Mark 1.0; Google scan of an Oxford University copy (a Taylor Institution stamp is legible in the OCR).
Provenance note: Header prepended by the library thread; the OCR text follows unchanged, apart from this header. Rights basis: the 1834 title-page date clears this registry's public-domain-by-date rule; the host's Public Domain Mark agrees. The Google Books boilerplate page at the head of the OCR is left in place. OCR artifacts are left as found; nothing was corrected, re-spaced or retyped.
Content note: Vendored as context for 1453, not as church voice: Doukas's history runs to the fall of Constantinople. The volume also carries Boulliau's epistle and, as Bekker's preface says, the old Italian version of Doukas. Greek and Latin OCR are both readable, with some accent errors.

Numeri annorum a primo hominc ad aetatem nostram. 


1. Αι Adamo primo homine usque ad Noachum, cuius aevo 
diluvium accidit, decem exactae sunt generationes. prima cum Adam 
a deo creatus ost, post annos 230 secunda, cum Sethus nascitur Adamo, 
post Sethum annis 205 tertia; tunc Enos Setho natus est, post Enos 
annis 197 quarta, quando Cainanus nascitur Enos. post Cainanum 
annis 170 quinta: nascitur Maleleel filius Cainani. post Maleleelem 
annis 165 sexta: Iaredus nascitur Maleleelo. post laredum annis 164 
septima: Enochus nascitur laredo. post Enochum annis 165 octava: 
Mathusala nascitur Enocho. post Mathusalam annis 167 nona: Lamechus
